description: Breaks one phasor into three nested rhythmic layers — steps, groups of steps and subgroups — each with a phasor output and a trigger output

params.text: Sets how many steps one cycle of the input phasor is split into, 1 to 64, 16 when new
Attenuverts the steps CV, -1 to +1; at full depth 5V adds 64 steps
Sets how many steps make a group, 1 to 64, 7 when new; a group that does not fit the bar is cut short when the input phasor restarts
Attenuverts the group steps CV, -1 to +1; at full depth 5V adds 64 steps
Sets how many steps make a subgroup within the group, 1 to 64, 3 when new
Attenuverts the subgroup steps CV, -1 to +1; at full depth 5V adds 64 steps

inputs.text: The phasor being divided; one 0-10V cycle is the whole bar
Adds to the step count, scaled by the steps attenuverter
Adds to the group step count, scaled by the group steps attenuverter
Adds to the subgroup step count, scaled by the subgroup steps attenuverter

outputs.text: A 0-10V ramp across the current step, restarting on every step
A 1ms 10V trigger at the start of every step
A 0-10V ramp across the current group of steps
A 1ms 10V trigger at the start of every group
A 0-10V ramp across the current subgroup
A 1ms 10V trigger at the start of every subgroup

notes: the larger of the group and subgroup settings is taken as the group and the smaller as the subgroup, and a change to either takes effect at the next step
a phasor drives this, not a clock: a ramp rising from 0V to 10V once per cycle, from Phasor Generator, Clock to Phasor or an LFO's saw output. Nothing moves here until one is patched in.
